For "anti-aging" and more energy: what is sold, what the evidence says, and what is not even a peptide.

No peptide is approved for aging or energy. Since 30 Oct 2026 an HHS policy lets licensed pharmacies compound Epitalon and MOTS-c under conditions; neither is FDA approved.

  • Epitalon · vials sold as an anti-aging shotNot approved; HHS allows limited pharmacy compounding (Oct 2026)research use only

    A short peptide sold as an anti-aging shot, in vials for lab use. Not approved; human evidence is thin.

    A four-amino-acid peptide sold as an "anti-aging" shot; human evidence is thin and old. Covered by the HHS compounding policy of Oct 2026. 13
